text:
**Brief: Willow work plan**

Write a work plan for six components: upload, billing, webhooks, quota, ledger, pricing. Use only these values and rules.

Settings: webhooks.max_workers=14; pricing.timeout_s=35; billing.retry_limit=5; ledger.timeout_s=95. Derived limits: ledger.timeout_s>85 so quota.retry_limit≤2; billing.retry_limit>3 so quota.batch_size≤200.

Workers: only alpha runs webhooks and owns pricing. Billing and upload run on different workers. Quota and upload run on the same worker.

Dependencies: upload depends on pricing. Pricing runs before ledger. Quota must have no path to pricing, direct or transitive, and must not depend on upload.

types.py and tokens.py belong to upload.

Code review turnaround: under one day.

You decide upload ttl_s and database choices. Ignore legacy values and meeting notes.
